name: Ikal Kila
bio:
[HI! Ikal an Illustrator from Indonesia.
I am an illustrator who focuses on depicting various human emotions and feelings. Through my art, I strive to convey the intricacies of a person's inner world. My illustrations serve as windows into the human soul, with each stroke and color choice communicating unspoken sentiments. My dedication to representing the spectrum of emotions makes me a storyteller of the heart, using my talent to bridge the gap between the visible and the felt.]
